export function QRCode({
  value,
  size = 160,
  level = 'M',
  className,
  color = '#202124',
  background = '#ffffff',
  status = 'active',
  onRefresh,
  downloadable = false,
  downloadFormat = 'svg',
  icon,
}: {
  value: string
  size?: number
  level?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H'
  className?: string
  color?: string
  background?: string
  status?: 'active' | 'loading' | 'expired' | 'scanned'
  onRefresh?: () => void
  downloadable?: boolean
  downloadFormat?: 'svg' | 'png'
  icon?: string
}): React.JSX.Element
